title: Coverage Determination Conditions — Real Estate Service Contracts
content:
**Standard.** One coverage determination is issued per service request under a Real Estate Service Contracts plan; whether one already exists is read from the claim records of that request. A failure is covered only when every condition below holds, and otherwise is not covered with the first failing reason in this order.

| Order | Condition that must hold | Reason recorded when it fails |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | A seller listing request was placed while the contract was in listing coverage, or a buyer request was placed on or after the closing date on a contract that is now active. | contract not in force |
| 2 | The plan's limit for the item is above $0.00 and, in the seller phase, the item is not heating, cooling or ductwork unless the plan's seller heating-and-cooling coverage is Yes, and is not a roof leak. | item not in plan |
| 3 | Applies only to plans whose systems coverage delay is above 0 days: for such a plan, a failure of the heating system, cooling system, ductwork, plumbing, water heater or electrical system is covered only when it is reported at least the plan's systems coverage delay, in calendar days, after the sale closes, counting from the day after the closing date with the boundary day included. | systems coverage not started |
| 4 | In the seller phase, conditions existing before the order date are never covered; in the buyer phase, known or detectable pre-existing conditions are never covered, and unknown, undetectable ones are covered only when the plan's unknown pre-existing coverage is Yes and, where the plan's inspection requirement is Yes, the order shows a home inspection completed before closing. | pre-existing condition |
| 5 | Misuse and external causes are never covered. | misuse or external damage |
| 6 | The remaining item benefit and the remaining aggregate benefit, as the benefit authorization limits work them out, are both above zero. | cap exhausted |

## Condition 3 counted out

The clock starts from the sale closing, as shown by the closing date on the contract record, and the report date is the request date. On a plan whose systems coverage delay is 365 days, counting from the day after the closing date:

| Day on which a heating, cooling, ductwork, plumbing, water heater or electrical failure is reported | Condition 3 |
|---|---|
| day 364 | not met: systems coverage not started |
| day 365 (the boundary day) | met |

On a plan whose systems coverage delay is 0, condition 3 does not apply.

## Condition 4 in the buyer phase

| Kind of pre-existing condition | Plan covers unknown pre-existing conditions | Inspection required by the plan | Inspection completed before closing per the order | Condition 4 |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| known or detectable | any | any | any | not met |
| unknown, undetectable | No | any | any | not met |
| unknown, undetectable | Yes | Yes | No | not met |
| unknown, undetectable | Yes | Yes | Yes | met |

## Reading the order of reasons (hypothetical request)

A hypothetical buyer-phase request for a roof leak on a plan whose roof leak limit is $0.00, where the leak also arises from external damage, fails condition 2 and condition 5; the determination is not covered with the reason "item not in plan", the first failing reason in the order.
